open: Start on the actual broken Arabic dashboard, then the Procurement orders page.
run: No command; compare both real apps.
observe: Both apps translate labels, yet share form/table/shell symptoms.
meaning: A shared symptom suggests investigating ownership; this is an investigation strategy, not proof that one line causes every issue.
ar: قبل ما نصلّح، لازم نعرف كل جزء مسؤول عن إيه. نفس مشكلة المحاذاة ظهرت في تطبيقين، فهنبدأ من الحاجات المشتركة.
en: Before changing code, identify responsibility. Similar alignment symptoms occur in both applications, so begin with what they share.

open: Open package.json, nx.json, and both project.json files in actual VS Code.
run: npm run  # lists existing scripts, without starting tasks
observe: dev selects invoicing:dev; dev:procurement selects procurement:dev; @nx/vite/plugin infers dev/build targets.
meaning: Nx coordinates projects/tasks; it is not a production application server or a business backend.
ar: ده Nx monorepo: تطبيق للفواتير وتطبيق للمشتريات، ومعاهم مكتبات وأدوات. أوامر التشغيل بتختار المشروع؛ Nx بينظم المهام، مش بيحسب الفواتير.
en: This Nx monorepo contains two applications, shared libraries, and tools. Development scripts select projects; Nx coordinates tasks rather than invoice calculations.

concept: Trust imports, not missing graph edges
open: Open tsconfig.json and actual App/main imports. Show the prepared import-grounded diagram.
run: Read the cached graph receipt; optionally generate a new graph only when filming is approved.
observe: Aliases resolve @atlas/design-system and @atlas/shared. Cached graph lists five workspace nodes but no workspace-node edges.
meaning: The hand-authored diagram documents verified imports; it is not presented as Nx-generated output or runtime timing.
ar: الـimports بتوضح إن التطبيقين بيستخدموا design-system وshared. لو Nx graph ما أظهرش العلاقة، ده مش معناه إنها مش موجودة. الخريطة دي مبنية على الكود.
en: Both applications import the design system and shared library. Missing Nx graph edges do not erase those imports. This separate diagram is grounded in source.

concept: Separate UI ownership from business data
open: Open design-system/index.tsx, then shared/index.ts. Reveal one library at a time.
run: No runtime command; use VS Code Go to Definition on AppShell and total.
observe: AppShell/FormField/DataTable/Modal are shared presentation; fixtures, money, total, mockApi are shared business helpers.
meaning: A shared component affects both consumers. A presentation change must preserve IDs, statuses and amounts.
ar: الـdesign-system مسؤول عن الـShell والحقول والجداول والـDialog. shared فيها البيانات وحساب المجموع واللغة. هنغيّر طريقة العرض بعدين، من غير ما نغيّر معنى البيانات.
en: The design system owns the shell, fields, tables, and dialogs. Shared supplies data, totals, and locale support. Presentation changes must preserve business meaning.

concept: Follow the real React provider tree
open: Open both main.tsx files. Highlight the actual nesting in order.
run: No new command; inspect createRoot(...).render(...) at line8.
observe: StrictMode → Provider → BrowserRouter → LocaleProvider → App in this Study tree.
meaning: Provider is an ancestor of LocaleProvider, and currently always selects the LTR theme. Do not show the migrated reference provider as active Study code.
ar: نقطة البداية main.tsx. الـProvider برّه الـRouter والـLocaleProvider. في نسخة الـStudy دي، الـProvider بيختار LTR theme ثابت؛ وجود rtlTheme لوحده مش معناه إنه مستخدم.
en: Each entry mounts the provider, router, locale provider, and application. In Study, the styling provider always selects the LTR theme; exporting an RTL theme does not activate it.

open: Open i18n.tsx and use the real selector in the browser.
observe: Selector → setLanguage → navigate query → LocaleProvider derives language → translator/useLayoutEffect sets html.lang/dir.
meaning: Arabic requires demo=unmigrated-rtl AND lang=ar. Plain / has no demo selector. This flow does not translate stored business statuses.
ar: لما نختار العربي، setLanguage بيغيّر الـquery عن طريق الـRouter. LocaleProvider يختار الترجمة ويضبط lang وdir على المستند. لكن ده مش بيغيّر حالة الفاتورة المخزّنة.
en: Selecting Arabic updates the URL through the router. LocaleProvider derives translations and document language/direction. It does not rewrite the invoice’s stored status.

concept: Language direction is not the styling engine
open: Open runtime.tsx, styles.css, and SidebarFrame; return to the actual misaligned field.
run: Read code; no DOM style patches or theme changes.
observe: ThemeProvider uses theme.direction=ltr; Study has no active CacheProvider/RTL Stylis pipeline. SidebarFrame uses Emotion styled; legacy CSS uses physical margin-left.
meaning: Document direction, MUI direction, Emotion style transformation and explicit component geometry are distinct owners. Evidence supports a mismatch; no repair in this scene.
ar: هنا الفرق: المستند RTL، لكن MUI لسه LTR. وفيه Emotion styled وCSS قديم بمسافات ثابتة. تغيير اللغة وحده مش بيوحّد الطبقات دي؛ لازم نفهم مين بيملك كل قرار.
en: Document direction is RTL while MUI remains LTR. Emotion-styled components and physical legacy CSS also participate. Language selection alone does not align these separate styling owners.

concept: Follow one real invoice, not a fictional backend
open: Open seedInvoices/listInvoices/App, then the real INV-2026-1048 detail route.
observe: Fixture fallback → mockApi localStorage read → App state → table/detail → total/money. First invoice: Northstar Studio, Pending, USD4800.
meaning: No network backend is involved in listInvoices. Existing origin-local storage can override fixture data; use an isolated filming context.
ar: الفاتورة 1048 جاية من seedInvoices لو مفيش بيانات محفوظة. mockApi يقراها، App يحتفظ بيها، والـTable والـDetails يعرضوها. total يحسب 4800، وmoney ينسّقها؛ العربي ما يغيّرش القيمة.
en: Invoice1048 falls back to seed data when storage is empty. The mock API hydrates App state; table and detail views consume it. Total computes4800 and money formats it without changing the amount.

open: Show tools folder and CLI/report imports briefly, then pause for the next lesson.
run: Do not execute the Scanner in this scene. Commands will be reviewed interactively next.
observe: CLI supports json, markdown, summary; default remains JSON. Tools are not mounted React UI dependencies.
meaning: Static evidence/findings are investigation leads, not automatic proof of a visible bug or safe Codemod approval.
ar: دلوقتي عرفنا حدود النظام. في المشهد الجاي هنشغّل الـScanner مع بعض، ونفرّق بين Evidence وFinding وعيب شفناه فعلًا، قبل أي تعديل.
en: With ownership established, investigate the Scanner interactively next. Separate extracted evidence and static findings from reproduced UI defects before approving any change.
